urban environmental quality and urban human well-being are important factors for sustainable urban development.
the urban environmental quality and the human well-being in a sustainable city are interrelated.

In summary, our research is concerned with
how to achieve a sustainable and liveable urban environment.
how the urban environment affects human well-being and vice versa.
how the built environment can be designed to promote human comfort, health and well-being.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of life is a complex phenomenon that is affected by various factors, including social and economic conditions.
the present research is a step in the direction of a holistic understanding of the complex and dynamic nature of urban environmental quality in the context of urban development.

sustainable urban development is a complex, multi-dimensional, and dynamic phenomenon, and it is a process that requires the integration of many disciplines, and the involvement of a broad range of stakeholders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have attempted to understand the urban environment in terms of its social, economic and environmental dimensions.
the urban environment is a dynamic system and that it is a system that is constantly changing and adapting to the changes in the surrounding natural and social environments.

urban planning with respect to the environment and human well-being is a process of managing the quality of the urban environment and human well being to improve the standard of living and quality of life in the city.
The main takeaway from our work is that

sustainable development can be achieved by considering the following factors: 1) the relationship of urban environmental quality with human well-being; 2) urban environmental quality and urban planning; and 3) the relationship of sustainable urban development with urban environmental quality and well-being.
the urban environment is a complex and dynamic system, which is influenced by various factors.
urban planning should be done with respect to environmental and human well-being.
